author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-AdaptPC: ComBat-PCA64 Whitened Embedding (tau=0.95) + Equal-Quota Graph
abstract: Keep the EID 185 graph (adaptive residualized PCs, k=48, equal quotas). Modify only the embedding: after ComBat+PCA64, whiten PCs to unit variance and apply a tiny isotropic shrink (tau=0.95). Goal: modest ARI/NMI gains without hurting mixing.
